title: PTD-aux self-prediction as a §7-legitimate self-supervised PRETEXT for the §55 .kosmos multimodal encoder

question: Can the PTD-aux self-prediction objective serve as a §7-legitimate SELF-SUPERVISED PRETEXT for the §55-constrained .kosmos multimodal encoder WITHOUT recursing to §1.1?
verdict_detail: {W1,W2} disjunction is EXHAUSTIVE for 'PTD-aux as E_m pretext'. W1 (PTD-aux as it exists, §44/§59) = §7③-sourced (own physics) but NOT an encoder pretext (no payload_m front-end edge; §58 PTD-aux ≅ NONE / §59-FIRE READ-OUT) = verdict (c)'s read-out-only character. W2 (PTD-aux FORM on E_m's representation stream) = a real encoder pretext but its information source IS the encoder-input perceptual modality ⟹ RECURSES-TO-§1.1 for image/audio/video (the §55 §7②-wall / §51 frontier-1 data). W2 = §56 rank-2 §7②-rationale-trap re-instantiated (passes §7② letter, fails rationale). NO §7-legitimate-non-recursive wiring exists. Self-supervised removes the need for LABELS, never for DATA — the diverse perceptual data is the §1.1 irreducible bottleneck §51/§55/§62 already located.
